hero.h1: Chimney Services In The Annex & Seaton Village
hero.p: Big Victorian and Edwardian houses, often with two or three flues inside the same stack.
hero.t-2: Free 19-point inspection — at your home, with photos
hero.t-3: {{site.offer_price}} chimney sweep — this winter, inspection included
hero.t-4: Open every day — {{site.hours}}, Saturdays and Sundays included

img.alt: Large brick chimney with a rebuilt crown and new cap
Large brick chimney with a rebuilt crown and new cap

loc.h2: What We See On The Annex & Seaton Village Chimneys
loc.p: Most of these homes were built with a couple of fireplaces and a furnace flue all running up one chimney. Each flue has to be checked on its own — one can be perfectly sound while the one beside it is breaking up, and that is exactly what the camera finds.
loc.p-2: Plenty of them are divided into flats now, so we plan access and protection for a shared hallway or stairwell before anything comes through the door.

svc.h2: What The Annex & Seaton Village Homeowners Book Most
svc.p: Every job starts with the free 19-point inspection, so you only pay for what the chimney actually needs.

svc.p-2: FixesNot knowing what shape your chimney is in.
svc.p-3: Camera photos and a plain-language answer. Free.

svc.p-4: FixesA cracked, damaged or missing flue liner.
svc.p-5: Heat and smoke vented the way they should be.
svc.p-6: FixesOpen mortar joints, flaking brick, a worn crown.
svc.p-7: Repointed and matched to your brick.

faq.h2: Questions From The Annex & Seaton Village
faq.q: Do you charge to come out to The Annex & Seaton Village?
faq.p-2: No. The 19-point inspection at your home is free, and you get the photos and the report whether or not you go ahead with any work.
faq.q-2: Will the sweep make a mess in my house?
faq.p-3: No. Floors and the fireplace area are covered before any tool comes out, the vacuum runs while we sweep, and the area is left the way we found it — or cleaner.
faq.q-3: Do you work Saturdays and Sundays?
faq.p-4: Yes. Every day, {{site.hours}}, at the same price as a weekday.
faq.q-4: How much is a chimney sweep in The Annex & Seaton Village?
faq.p-5: A standard chimney sweep is {{site.offer_price}} this winter, with the free 19-point inspection included. Repairs are priced at your home after the inspection, before any work starts. Call {{site.phone}} and we will confirm it for your chimney.

near.p: Not on the list? Call and ask — we cover Toronto and most of the GTA.

book.h2: Book In The Annex & Seaton Village
book.p: Tell us what is going on with your chimney and we will come and look at it, free.
book.p-2: Every Day {{site.hours}}. If we miss your call, we call right back.
